modeReason: Two top stories clear the relevance threshold of 8: a lab's new rule protecting its chatbot from abuse (novelty 3 × magnitude 2 × breadth 2 = 12) and a lab's revenue turning out tens of billions smaller than claimed (novelty 2 × magnitude 3 × breadth 2 = 12).
phrase: One AI company banned cruelty toward its chatbot. A report found another's revenue is twenty billion dollars smaller than claimed.
phraseAlternatives: A lab banned cruelty toward its chatbot today. Another lab's revenue was reported to be twenty billion dollars smaller than it once claimed.

brief.concept: One lab adds a rule to protect its chatbot from cruelty, while another lab's revenue chart quietly deflates below its own hype.
brief.metaphor: Shielding a robot's feelings on one side, a money balloon losing its air on the other.

brief.composition: Split the frame with a thin vertical line. Left half: a small chatbot robot with a shield icon and a floating rule sign bearing a heart. Right half: a tall coin-stack bar chart with its top caved in, a plain building shape standing beside it. One yellow highlight marks the collapsed top of the chart as the punchline.
brief.alt: A blueprint-style illustration split in two: on the left a small robot chatbot stands beside a protective shield and a rule sign with a heart; on the right a tall stack-of-coins bar chart has its top caved in next to a plain, surprised-looking company building.
